# Starter stills

One picture per starter (`<id>.png`), shown on the Studio's New-project dialog. Each is a frame of the starter playing on the real runtime in TSRun
(`tests/arcade-starters-a.mjs` with `STARTERS_SHOTS=<dir> STARTERS_SHOT_EVERY=60` writes frames of the four v2 starters; the platformer, raycaster and
wireframe frames were made the same way from the bot scripts of `tests/arcade-starters-b.mjs`). Stills are for the dialog only; nothing reads them.
